caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a pale face, short dark brown or black hair, and red lips. The doll is dressed in a blue outfit consisting of a jacket with a V-shaped neckline and matching pants, both shaded with dark blue tones. Underneath the jacket, a light-colored shirt or scarf with beige or cream hues covers the doll's neck and upper chest, with visible folds and shading. The doll's hands are designed in simple mitten-like shapes with a beige color, and the feet are covered in black or very dark brown socks and shoes, with the laces on the right shoe visible. The background is an unadorned, light beige or off-white color. The artist's signature "V. Van Voris" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Rag Doll "Johnnie"
